//: Reviewed escapes for the test-quality gate (tools/check-test-quality.mjs): tests that are deliberately DISABLED (.skip/.todo/xit) or that deliberately carry no assertion. Keyed by '<file>::<test title>' — the TITLE, not a line number, so an entry survives the file being reformatted or the test moving. A reason is MANDATORY: a test that does not run is a hole in the net that every coverage number still counts as covered, so leaving one is a decision, not an oversight. There is NO escape for `.only` — a focused test silently disables the entire rest of the suite, and no reason makes that acceptable in a commit. This file is write-guard-protected and hashed by gate-integrity. A stale entry (its file is gone — e.g. an opt-in module this tier does not install) is ignored, not an error.

allow.test: tests/rls/cross-tenant-isolation.test.ts::cross-tenant isolation via the Supabase client (skipped: no local stack)
allow.reason: The SDK RLS suite's documented self-skip, and it FAILS CLOSED where it matters. It needs a running `supabase start` stack; `node tests/rls/run-rls.mjs` starts from that stack, sets RLS_SUITE_READY=1, and in CI a skip is an ERROR (CI=true makes the runner fail closed). So the skipped branch exists only so a plain `vitest run` on a laptop with no stack stays green instead of erroring — it is the local-dev affordance, not a disabled test. The enforcing branch is the one CI runs (alongside the pgTAP twin, supabase/tests/*.sql).

The same documented self-skip as the cross-tenant suite above, and it fails closed the same way: the enforcing branch needs a running `supabase start` stack, `node tests/rls/run-rls.mjs` supplies it and sets RLS_SUITE_READY=1, and in CI a skip is an ERROR. The skipped branch exists only so a plain `vitest run` on a laptop with no stack stays green instead of erroring. This layer has a second enforcer that cannot be skipped at all: rls_structure.test.sql reads every role x knob pair straight out of pg_db_role_setting, so a ceiling that is merely text in a migration reds pgTAP whether or not this suite runs.
